Summary:

A story written in drabbles, using the 2026 Sidlotte September daily prompts. ❤️

As we join them – in an intentionally unspecified location – Sidney and Charlotte are extremely close to each other and he is struggling to deal with how that is affecting him.

Note: A drabble is “a piece of fiction that is exactly 100 words long.”

Chapter 1: Ink

Chapter Text

It was the one little luxury he always had with him, an actual pen with actual ink. It wasn’t necessary, not really, but Sidney appreciated how the tactile sensation of using it made him feel grounded after the upheaval of recent days.

Charlotte did not have an equivalent item, he didn’t think. Something to soothe her through the chaos. He returned his attention to his notebook, careful not to catch her eye.

At least they were now pointed in the right direction and could keep moving. Together, for as long as possible. It would never be long enough for Sidney.
